dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What were you muttering to yourself about?

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Sara decided she wanted to import Liyue chili peppers recently. Allegedly, they're hot enough to reduce even Mondstadt's die-hard spice lover Barbara to tears.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: My view is they'd be nigh on impossible to sell, seeing as eighty-six percent of Mondstadters won't touch them.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Oh, you hadn't heard? It was my understanding that everyone in Mondstadt knew.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Tell me some more things that everyone in Mondstadt knows.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Things like when Outrider Amber volunteered to cook at the last Knights of Favonius get-together, burnt the steak, and smoked out the whole kitchen?

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Even though Amber made everyone there promise to never tell a soul...

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: ...I think you might be the last person in Mondstadt to hear about it.

choices.text: You should tell her about your concerns.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: If I can't think of anything better, I may have to send in Prince Charming...

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Kaeya's got a certain way with words. He would only need to drop a few subtle hints and the whole thing would be sorted.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Ahem. Anyway. Thanks for the chat.
